title: Ops pulse shift handoff - 2027-09-29
content:
Context: quick afternoon handoff between US/AU shifts. Focus: live panel rollout status, recent analytics spike, and a small UI regression reported by support. This is a lightweight capture — not a full postmortem.

Facilitator: Priya Menon
Time: 2027-09-29 15:10 PT (15 min)
Attendees: Priya, Ethan, Marina, Liam (ops), Jana (support - joined for first 10 min)

Agenda:
- 60s each: what shipped / what broke
- Canary metrics + telemetry anomaly
- Quick triage of reported UI regression in panel settings
- Assign immediate actions for overnight / APAC shift

Notes / Updates:
1) Rollout status (panel-feature-2027Q3)
- Canary cohort (5% traffic) at 29h. Successful request pass rate 99.1% but error surface shows small uptick in 500s for requests with long prompts (>8k tokens).
- Action taken: throttled burst queue for canary nodes (Ethan). Rolling back the kernel optimizer change on those nodes (PR linked).
- Decision: pause further ramp until root cause triaged. Target: hold at 5% through APAC morning.
- Relevant tickets: ENG-3218 (canary error spike), GH PR #1872 (kernel change revert).

2) Analytics ingestion spike (telemetry pipeline)
- Overnight ingestion spike peaked at 2.8x baseline (03:20 PT). Source: malformed client-side events from a staging embed test (not prod), but they ended up hitting prod ingestion due to mis-routed key.
- Marina throttled the stream and applied a filter rule; backfill planned to correct aggregated metrics.
- Short term: ignore the spike for daily dashboards; longer term: need stricter environment-key routing in edge lambda.
- Linked: ENG-3275 (telemetry filter rule + backfill plan).

3) UI regression: settings pane loses focus after toggling 'Auto-rollout'
- Reported by support (Jana). Repro steps in the ticket: open settings -> toggle Auto-rollout -> focus returns to top of modal, keyboard nav interrupted.
- Root cause hypothesis: focus trap logic conflicts with new async save debounce.
- Quick mitigation: temporary disable keyboard autofocus on the modal for affected builds. Marina to patch and ship a hotfix branch into staging; PR to follow.

Decisions made:
- Pause ramp to 20% for panel-feature-2027Q3 until canary 500s anomaly explained. (Owner: Ethan)
- Ignore telemetry spike for alerting windows and resume normal alarms after backfill completes. (Owner: Marina)
- Hotfix for settings focus regression prioritized for next deploy window (Owner: Marina, ETA: 2027-09-30 morning PT).

Action items (owner - due):
- Ethan: Complete canary node rollback verification and upload kernel logs to ENG-3218. Due 2027-09-29 EOD PT.
- Marina: Push telemetry filter to edge, start backfill job, and post backfill status in #console-telemetry. Due 2027-09-30 10:00 PT.
- Marina + Liam: Patch modal focus hotfix, open PR, and run UX sanity tests. Due 2027-09-30 morning.
- Priya: Draft short status blurb for CS + PMs explaining pause and ETA. Due 2027-09-29 17:00 PT.
- Jana (support): Collect 3 user repros and attach console logs to the UI regression ticket. Due 2027-09-29 EOD.

Risks / Open questions:
- If the 500s are due to kernel optimizer behavior with long-prefix caching, other models with longer KV usage could be affected. Need model team runbook.
- Backfill may distort weekly alert thresholds; proposal: tag backfilled datapoints and exclude from SLO calcs for this week. (Follow-up: Eng infra + SRE sync).
- Do we need a short lived feature-flag rollback path in the routing layer to avoid node-level kernel changes in future?

Notes to self / meeting crumbs:
- Check whether the canary nodes were using a different quantization profile (I think they were on q5b). If so, we should capture weight diffs.
- Remember to ping model-ops channel about potential downstream model impacts.
- Put a short line in next week's retro: "canary isolation gaps".

Next check-in / handoff:
- Overnight owner: Liam (APAC shift) — take over canary watch and telemetry alarms.
- Follow-up sync: 2027-09-30 09:30 PT (standup) to confirm hotfix & backfill progress.

Quick links / bookmarks:
- Canary error ticket: ENG-3218
- Telemetry filter & backfill: ENG-3275
- Kernel revert PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/1872
- UX regression ticket: ENG-3287 (created during meeting)

End of notes.

(Informal: short, messy — leaving raw kernel log pointers in ENG-3218 so SRE can grep. If anyone who takes the handoff wants more context, ping me or drop a quick Loom.)
